scripts.build: npm run build:go && npm run build:addon

scripts.build:darwin:arm64: TARGET_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/build-go.js && node-gyp rebuild --arch=arm64 && TARGET_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/copy-prebuild.js
